name: Arcane Grimoire, +2

source.note: Entered from knowledge (personal build); text and summary are ours. The Arcane Grimoire is printed in Tasha's Cauldron of Everything (p.120); the 2024 DMG's item lists (aidedd's index, D&D Beyond's chapter 7 lists) do not show it, so the 2024 wording is not confirmed here. What the sources agree on and the item now follows (owner, 2026-10-18: a focus for Wizards, not a spellbook): attunement by a Wizard; uncommon +1, rare +2, very rare +3; while held it is a Spellcasting Focus for Wizard spells and adds its bonus to their spell attack rolls and save DCs; Arcane Recovery restores one more slot level. Check against the owner's copy; it is not a spellbook and holds no spells.

summary: A Wizard's Spellcasting Focus: +2 to your Wizard spell attack rolls and save DCs while you hold it, and Arcane Recovery brings back one more slot level.
text: A leather-bound book of arcane lore, made for Wizards. A Wizard attuned to it can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for their Wizard spells, and while they hold it those spells gain +2 to their spell attack rolls and their saving throw DCs. Whenever they use Arcane Recovery, the total of spell slot levels they regain rises by 1. It is not a spellbook: it holds no spells, no spell can be copied into it or out of it, and it cannot stand in for the Wizard's own spellbook.
